pages.text: $(l:world/royal_synthesis)Royal synthesis$() creates this companion. It starts in Wait with ordinary Mining Slime health, stamina, tools, and bags. Normal excavates its chunk; Ore Priority favors visible ores in the active layer.
pages.title: Next-Generation Mining Slime

pages.text: Open its Tuner management screen and choose Policy. Selective Ore uses the enabled Forge ore tags: coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald, quartz, and ancient debris. Only visible, accessible selected ores qualify. It never digs surrounding stone to reach a hidden deposit.

Protected stairs stay protected. Blocked deposits get the usual work warnings, tool supply, and cargo pickup. Selective Ore does not quarry, drain terrain, or build walls. A Scanner shows its local, chunk-clipped search window without revealing hidden ores. Recovery, revival, travel, and orders follow normal companion rules.
